summary: Iteration-5 full regression + new feature testing after big backend split, hook extraction, aggregation optimization, and two-way typing preview. Backend: 43/43 pytest passed (backend_test.py 32, test_new_features.py 8, test_iter5_refactor.py 2, test_iter3_fixes.py 1). Frontend: dashboard, tabs, dark-mode, quick replies, send/edit/delete, archive search all work. Two-way typing preview verified end-to-end via Playwright: customer typing shows on agent [data-testid=typing-preview] and agent typing shows on customer widget [data-testid=agent-typing-preview]. Aggregation dynamic count verified: fresh agent 0 -> 3 open sessions -> count=3 -> close one -> count=2.

issues: Date range filter uses browser-native <input type='date'> pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar component (inconsistent with rest of the design system).

action_items: (Optional/design) Swap native date inputs in archive filter for shadcn Calendar/DatePicker to keep UI consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend split is clean: absolute imports work under supervisor CWD=/app/backend. Routers all mounted with correct /api prefixes. server.py is now a thin composition.

services.list_agents_with_load() correctly replaces N serial count_documents calls with a single $lookup+$arrayElemAt aggregation. Projection includes all required fields (id, email, name, role, status, active_chat_count) and appends max_active_chats per-agent — good.
routers/ws.py ws_agent 'typing' branch (lines 76-86) and ws_customer 'typing' branch (lines 153-163) both send preview=content when is_typing else empty string — matches the new-feature spec exactly.
Closed-chat guard on both WS sides (ws.py L52-58 and L144-150) preserved after refactor.
Auto_busy reconnect logic preserved in ws_agent connect block (L28-40) and finally block (L102-111).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: test agent + 20 sessions (test_iter3_fixes cap flow), test agent + 3 sessions (test_iter5_refactor aggregation), various TEST_ prefixed sessions from other tests. Test agents cleaned up in finally blocks; sessions remain closed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All regression + new-feature tests green. To rerun: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest tests/ -v -o addopts='' — the -o override is needed because pytest.ini enables xdist which slows down single-worker tests. Frontend testids: tab-active/tab-archived (not dashboard-tab-*), theme-toggle (not dark-mode-toggle). Two-way typing preview elements: [data-testid=typing-preview] on agent side, [data-testid=agent-typing-preview] on customer widget.
